product_one_liner.value: koppla provides collaborative construction scheduling software that helps general contractors, planners, property developers and architects plan projects, coordinate work and identify delays.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage identifies the target users, while the product-engineering posting describes collaborative scheduling and early identification of delays: https://www.koppla.de/ and https://koppla.jobs.personio.de/job/2871150?language=en

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page explains that pricing depends on the customer's requirements; published numerical prices are not required by the question: https://www.koppla.de/preise

raised_18mo.notes: The investor announcement states that koppla received €6 million on May 19, 2025, within the requested 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025: https://www.brandenburg-kapital.de/en/bk/news/newsdetailseite_516.html

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither of the two listed openings—Founders Associate and Senior Product Engineer—is an SDR, BDR or account-executive role: https://koppla.jobs.personio.de/?language=en

launched_6mo.notes: On October 6, 2026, koppla announced live critical-path calculation that automatically recalculates when a schedule changes—a substantive scheduling feature within the six-month window: https://linkedin.com/company/kopplasoftware

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown. The about page does not provide a complete dated executive roster, and no qualifying appointment or departure could be verified for the requested window. Absence of an announcement is insufficient to answer false: https://www.koppla.de/das-ist-koppla
